## NS.import() method

Dynamically import a script. Only scripts located from the same server can be imported. A dynamic import will not adjust RAM usage. This must be done manually with [ramOverride](./bitburner.ns.ramoverride.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
import(path: string): Promise<any>;
```
